kids: Tell Santa and Mrs. Claus a Christmas wish
Ride in a horse drawn wagon
Make a craft in the one room school
site: Historical Village at Weaver Park, 4021 Main St
about: Santa in the Train Station is a December afternoon at the Hilliard Historical Village, the museum campus at Weaver Park in downtown Hilliard.
Destination Hilliard, the city's visitor bureau, lists the event on Sunday, December 13, from 2 to 5 PM.
Santa and Mrs. Claus meet children at the village train station and the red caboose beside it.
Each child can share a Christmas wish while the grown ups snap pictures.
A horse drawn wagon ride carries guests around the village grounds.
Holiday music plays during the afternoon, and the rooms of the museum are decorated for Christmas.
Kids can sit down for a craft in the village school, a one room schoolhouse restored on the grounds.
The gift shop is open for browsing and each guest receives a complimentary cup of hot chocolate and a donut.
Admission is free, and donations to the historical society are welcome.
The event is separate from the city tree lighting a week earlier, which also uses the historical village.
faq: When is Santa in the Train Station in 2026?
Sunday, December 13, 2026, from 2 to 5 PM.
Where is it?
At the Historical Village and Museum at Weaver Park, 4021 Main St, Hilliard, OH 43026.
Is there a charge?
Admission is free and donations are welcome.
What can kids do?
Visit Santa and Mrs. Claus, ride a horse drawn wagon, make a craft in the school and tour the decorated museum rooms.
Are there treats?
Yes. Each guest gets a complimentary cup of hot chocolate and a donut.
Is it indoors or outdoors?
Both. The train station and wagon ride are outside and the museum rooms are indoors.
Who hosts it?
Destination Hilliard lists the event, which takes place at the historical village.

kids: Take a free photo with Santa and Mrs. Claus
Visit a Bridge Park pocket park
site: Pocket Park next to Rebol, Bridge Park
about: Santa in the Park is a free holiday photo stop in the Bridge Park district of Dublin, Ohio.
The City of Dublin calendar lists it on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from noon to 3 PM.
Families gather at the Pocket Park beside Rebol on Longshore Street.
Santa Claus and Mrs. Claus pose for photos at no charge.
The city asks families not to forget their letters to Santa.
North Pole mailboxes are placed throughout Bridge Park for children to drop them in.
The calendar entry links to the Bridge Park holiday page, which collects other seasonal activities in the district.
The park setting means the visit happens outdoors, so warm coats and gloves are a good idea.
The event is listed in the holiday category of the city events calendar.
It takes place a few days after the city tree lighting at Coffman Park, giving Dublin families a second Santa stop.
faq: When is Santa in the Park in Dublin in 2026?
Saturday, December 5, 2026, from noon to 3 PM.
Where is it?
At the Pocket Park next to Rebol in Bridge Park, 6568 Longshore St, Dublin, OH 43017.
Does it cost anything?
No. The photo with Santa and Mrs. Claus is free.

Yes. North Pole mailboxes are placed around Bridge Park.
Is the visit indoors?
No. It takes place outdoors in the park.
Who lists the event?
The City of Dublin events calendar.
Who can go?
Families of all ages.
